name: matrix augment method
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 通过扩展矩阵表示以构建或求解系统方程的方法。
usage_overview: 在考虑轨道板损伤的列车—轨道—桥梁动力分析中，用于将更新后的轨道板刚度填入预装配矩阵，减少刚度变化时的重复装配工作。

complete_examples.text: To improve the computational accuracy and efficiency, the combination of the matrix augment method and iterative solution algorithm is elucidated in detail.
Besides, an integrating solution by matrix augment method and iterative algorithm is proposed to improve the computational efficiency and accuracy.
